activity_statements.statement: operates 1,000+ consumer electronics retail stores across the United States and Canada serving customers in-store, online, and in-home
provides in-home tech installation, repair, and support services through Geek Squad (85,000+ employees)
sells consumer electronics, appliances, computers, mobile devices, and smart-home products to individual consumers and businesses
operates a health technology segment offering remote patient monitoring and senior-focused tech solutions

name_reality_gap: The 'Best Buy' name and 'Retail' label are honest but conceal that a substantial share of employees are field service technicians (Geek Squad) performing in-home tech installation, repair, and support work — making it as much a services business as a retailer.
extraction_notes: Main bestbuy.com about pages returned 404; only the bare corporate about page was available. Source was thin on specifics. Geek Squad and health segment details drawn from known public information. Extraction confidence moderate.
